verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. عَلَى «لَا تُهْلِكْ». لِدَاوُدَ. مُذَهَّبَةٌ
verses.en: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David; Michtam.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David.

verses.he: הַֽאֻמְנָ֗ם אֵ֣לֶם צֶ֭דֶק תְּדַבֵּר֑וּן מֵישָׁרִ֥ים תִּ֝שְׁפְּט֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.ar: أَحَقًّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْأَخْرَسِ تَتَكَلَّمُونَ، بِٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَاتِ تَقْضُونَ يَا بَنِي آدَمَ؟
verses.en: Do ye indeed speak as a righteous company? Do ye judge with equity the sons of men?
verses.kjv: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.web: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

verses.he: אַף־בְּלֵב֮ עֹולֹ֪ת תִּפְעָ֫ל֥וּן בָּאָ֡רֶץ חֲמַ֥ס יְ֝דֵיכֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּֽסֽוּן׃
verses.ar: بَلْ بِٱلْقَلْبِ تَعْمَلُونَ شُرُورًا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ ظُلْمَ أَيْدِيكُمْ تَزِنُونَ.
verses.en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh out in the earth the violence of your hands.
verses.kjv: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.web: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

verses.he: זֹ֣רוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מֵרָ֑חֶם תָּע֥וּ מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן דֹּבְרֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃
verses.ar: زَاغَ ٱلْأَشْرَارُ مِنَ ٱلرَّحِمِ. ضَلُّوا مِنَ ٱلْبَطْنِ، مُتَكَلِّمِينَ كَذِبًا.
verses.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the speakers of lies go astray as soon as they are born.
verses.kjv: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.web: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

verses.he: חֲמַת־לָ֗מֹו כִּדְמ֥וּת חֲמַת־נָחָ֑שׁ כְּמֹו־פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אָזְנֹֽו׃
verses.ar: لَهُمْ حُمَةٌ مِثْلُ حُمَةِ ٱلْحَيَّةِ. مِثْلُ ٱلصِّلِّ ٱلْأَصَمِّ يَسُدُّ أُذُنَهُ،
verses.en: Their venom is like the venom of a serpent; they are like the deaf asp that stoppeth her ear;
verses.kjv: Their poison [is] like the poison of a serpent: [they are] like the deaf adder [that] stoppeth her ear;
verses.web: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יִ֭שְׁמַע לְקֹ֣ול מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים חֹובֵ֖ר חֲבָרִ֣ים מְחֻכָּֽם׃
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي لَا يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَى صَوْتِ ٱلْحُوَاةِ ٱلرَّاقِينَ رُقَى حَكِيمٍ.
verses.en: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers, or of the most cunning binder of spells.
verses.kjv: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.web: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

verses.he: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרָס־שִׁנֵּ֥ימֹו בְּפִ֑ימֹו מַלְתְּעֹ֥ות כְּ֝פִירִ֗ים נְתֹ֣ץ ׀ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، كَسِّرْ أَسْنَانَهُمْ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمِ. ٱهْشِمْ أَضْرَاسَ ٱلْأَشْبَالِ يَارَبُّ.
verses.en: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth; break out the cheek-teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.kjv: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.web: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

verses.he: יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמֹו־מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־לָ֑מֹו יִדְרֹ֥ךְ *חִצֹּו (חִ֝צָּ֗יו) כְּמֹ֣ו יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ׃
verses.ar: لِيَذُوبُوا كَٱلْمَاءِ، لِيَذْهَبُوا. إِذَا فَوَّقَ سِهَامَهُ فَلْتَنْبُ.
verses.en: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace; when he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.
verses.kjv: Let them melt away as waters [which] run continually: [when] he bendeth [his bow to shoot] his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.web: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

verses.he: כְּמֹ֣ו שַׁ֭בְּלוּל תֶּ֣מֶס יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ נֵ֥פֶל אֵ֝֗שֶׁת בַּל־חָ֥זוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.ar: كَمَا يَذُوبُ ٱلْحَلَزُونُ مَاشِيًا. مِثْلَ سِقْطِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ لَا يُعَايِنُوا ٱلشَّمْسَ.
verses.en: Let them be as a snail which melteth and passeth away; like the untimely births of a woman, that have not seen the sun.
verses.kjv: As a snail [which] melteth, let [every one of them] pass away: [like] the untimely birth of a woman, [that] they may not see the sun.
verses.web: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

verses.he: בְּטֶ֤רֶם יָבִ֣ינוּ סִּֽירֹתֵיכֶ֣ם אָטָ֑ד כְּמֹו־חַ֥י כְּמֹו־חָ֝רֹ֗ון יִשְׂעָרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.ar: قَبْلَ أَنْ تَشْعُرَ قُدُورُكُمْ بِٱلشَّوْكِ، نِيئًا أَوْ مَحْرُوقًا، يَجْرُفُهُمْ.
verses.en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will sweep it away with a whirlwind, the raw and the burning alike.
verses.kjv: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in [his] wrath.
verses.web: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

verses.he: יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֭דִּיק כִּי־חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם פְּעָמָ֥יו יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ בְּדַ֣ם הָרָשָֽׁע׃
verses.ar: يَفْرَحُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُ إِذَا رَأَى ٱلنَّقْمَةَ. يَغْسِلُ خُطُواتِهِ بِدَمِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ.
verses.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance; he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.web: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

verses.he: וְיֹאמַ֣ר אָ֭דָם אַךְ־פְּרִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֑יק אַ֥ךְ יֵשׁ־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים שֹׁפְטִ֥ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ: «إِنَّ لِلصِّدِّيقِ ثَمَرًا. إِنَّهُ يُوجَدُ إِلَهٌ قَاضٍ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ»
verses.en: And men shall say: 'Verily there is a reward for the righteous; verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.'
verses.kjv: So that a man shall say, Verily [there is] a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
verses.web: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
